seo.title: Ngerulmud homeless help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social support for people experiencing homelessness in Ngerulmud.

page.heading: NGERULMUD - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger or medical emergency: 911. Violence support: Victims of Crime Advocates 775-8622. Mental-health crisis: 775-8255.
page.notice: Information and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: Ngerulmud is a small government centre. The Eastern Community Health Center serves Melekeok, but most social, legal and hospital services are in Koror, roughly 30 kilometres away. No general walk-in homeless shelter is publicly listed. Call services before travelling and confirm transport.
page.footer: Main sources: Palau Ministry of Health and Human Services, Palau Red Cross Society, Micronesian Legal Services Corporation and Palau Government.

entries.title: Eastern Community Health Center
entries.description: Public community health centre serving Melekeok, where Ngerulmud is located. An on-call provider number is published for after-hours advice.
entries.hours: Weekdays; closed for lunch and on weekends and holidays
entries.how_to_access: Call the centre or the on-call provider on 775-4236. Use 911 for an emergency.

entries.title: Palau Red Cross Society emergency line
entries.description: Humanitarian and single-incident emergency assistance, including support after house fires and disasters.
entries.address: Service based in Koror and available nationwide
entries.how_to_access: Call 775-SAFE or 775-PRCS and explain the situation.

entries.title: Palau Red Cross Society
entries.description: Humanitarian, health, homebound, caregiver and disaster assistance throughout Palau. Support depends on assessed need and current programmes.
entries.address: First Floor, Old OEK Building, Koror, Palau 96940
entries.how_to_access: Call the office or the 24-hour line before travelling from Ngerulmud.

entries.title: Eastern Community Health Center
entries.description: Nearest public community health centre for Melekeok and Ngerulmud.
entries.how_to_access: Call before visiting. After-hours on-call provider: 775-4236.

entries.title: Belau National Hospital
entries.description: Palau's national hospital in Koror, about 30 kilometres from Ngerulmud. It provides emergency and outpatient care.
entries.hours: Emergency room available; outpatient hours published online
entries.how_to_access: Call 488-2558 for the emergency room or 911 in an emergency. Confirm transport from Ngerulmud.

entries.title: Palau mental-health and suicide-prevention hotline
entries.how_to_access: Call 775-TALK. Use 911 if there is immediate danger.

entries.title: Palau Bureau of Human Resources
entries.description: Official government vacancies and application information. Applications require specified supporting documents, including identification and a current police clearance.
entries.how_to_access: Check current vacancies and requirements before travelling from Ngerulmud.

entries.title: Micronesian Legal Services Corporation - Palau
entries.description: Free civil legal assistance for eligible low-income residents, including family safety, identity documents, employment, land and civil-rights matters.
entries.how_to_access: Call before travelling. Eligibility is based on income, assets and case priorities.

entries.title: Victims of Crime Advocates
entries.description: Confidential support, guidance and assistance for people experiencing violence or abuse.
entries.how_to_access: Call 775-VOCA. Use 911 if there is immediate danger.
